Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The delta requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152507-feature-extend-arrowhead-size/requirements.md`.

### Key Verified Code Findings & Decisions Captured
- **Element model & omission of default (`packages/element/src/types.ts`, `packages/element/src/newElement.ts`):** `ExcalidrawLinearElement` gains optional `arrowheadSize`, shared by both heads. `newLinearElement` and `newArrowElement` omit the `"arrowheadSize"` property key entirely when at the default Medium size (`1` or `undefined`), preventing any existing element snapshot changes.
- **Restore sanitization (`packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts`):** Because `restoreElementWithProperties` spreads `...element`, `restoreElement` (`line` and `arrow`) explicitly retains valid non-default `arrowheadSize` values and deletes/omits the key when absent, default (`1`), or invalid.
- **Geometry & rendering (`packages/element/src/bounds.ts`, `packages/element/src/shape.ts`):** `getArrowheadSize`, `getArrowheadAngle`, `getCardinalityMarkerScale`, `getArrowheadSizeBeyondLastSegment`, and `getArrowheadPoints` scale the base per-type head size while keeping short-segment shrinking/growing and cardinality marker part proportions consistent. Both canvas and SVG export draw arrowheads via `getArrowheadShapes` → `getArrowheadPoints`. (`getElementBounds` / `getLinearElementRotatedBounds` measures only `shape[0]` shaft geometry and remains unchanged.)
- **Elbow routing & skeleton label clearance (`packages/element/src/elbowArrow.ts`, `packages/element/src/transform.ts`):** Decided in **FR-8** that both secondary `getArrowheadSize` readers (`elbowArrow.ts` around L1493/L1498 and `packages/element/src/transform.ts` `clampLabelPositionOffEnds` around L662) follow `arrow.arrowheadSize`, keeping default-size behavior byte-identical.
- **UI, AppState & Copy-Styles (`actionProperties.tsx`, `Actions.tsx`, `appState.ts`, `App.tsx`, `actionStyles.ts`):** `actionChangeArrowheadSize` (Small / Medium / Large) renders alongside `actionChangeArrowhead` (including in `actionChangeArrowProperties`), updates `currentItemArrowheadSize` (`{ browser: true, export: false, server: false }`), clears the element property when returning to Medium (using `force` in `newElementWith`), and reroutes elbow arrows when updated or style-pasted.
